checkpoints.description: [1/1] add a print_hex_line runtime twin that stores the newline just above the hex digits, and a codegen peephole that emits it for an adjacent discarded print_hex(x); print_char(10) pair; pin with failing-first shape and refusal tests, prove byte-identical output and a paired A/B win, record ADR and G-004 diff

impact_assessment.why: ADR-035 and the hex_io benchmark source record the second out_append per line as the remaining hex output cost; a paired A/B measured two appends at 31.53 ms best
impact_assessment.benefits: one append per line instead of two; paired interleaved A/B measured 31.53 to 26.76 ms best (-15.1 percent) with byte-identical 400,000-line output
impact_assessment.risks: contract: language semantics and IR translation must stay unchanged; dependency: the new helper reuses existing assembler methods, no new instruction; concurrency: none; state: no new static state, the newline lives in the existing frame buffer
impact_assessment.mitigation: the peephole is in codegen only so sema and ir see the original statements; refusal tests for a non-newline char and a used hex result; existing end-to-end and twin parity tests; full suite and gates

checkpoints.description: [1/1] teach codegen a str_len-guarded in-bounds index fact so a str_byte load inside 'while j < len' drops its dead NUL test and -1 fallback, with failing-first shape tests, refusals for unguarded and inclusive guards, an end-to-end scoping test, paired A/B with identical-binary control, ADR and G-004 diff

impact_assessment.why: a paired A/B on a contended host confirmed str_scan is a real loss (1.18x C, 1.23x C++) and its inlined byte load still pays a NUL test and miss constant that a str_len guard proves unreachable
impact_assessment.benefits: the scan inner loop drops two instructions per byte; paired A/B with a +1.3 percent identical-binary control measured -10.3 percent best
impact_assessment.risks: contract: str_byte(s, len) must still answer -1; dependency: no new instruction, reuses movzx_load8_sib; concurrency: none; state: facts are scoped to the guarded loop body
impact_assessment.mitigation: only a strict '<' guard with a proven non-negative index earns the fact, facts are invalidated on reassignment and restored at loop exit, and tests pin the inclusive and unguarded refusals plus the terminator read after the loop

checkpoints.description: [1/1] rotate the read_char scan so the EOF guard is the loop's conditional back-edge and the body falls through into the next fetch, removing the unconditional jump; failing-first shape and refusal tests, paired A/B with identical-binary control, ADR, full suite and gates

impact_assessment.why: char_stream is a confirmed 1.19x-C loss and its generic lowering fetched at the top then ended in an unconditional jump, while gcc's getchar loop uses a conditional back-edge
impact_assessment.benefits: the per-byte unconditional jump disappears; a paired A/B with a -0.1 percent control measured -4.8 percent best with byte-identical 4 MiB output
impact_assessment.risks: contract: EOF must still exit with the same checksum; dependency: reuses the promoted read_char inline with a caller-supplied join label; concurrency: none; state: no new static state
impact_assessment.mitigation: match only the exact three-statement while-true scan shape, keep one fetch site, refuse when the accumulator is not a register home, add a refusal test for a non-scan loop, and verify the four-language twin parity

checkpoints.description: [1/1] committed as 763193a: the read_char scan now has one fetch site that the entry jumps into, the accumulator add falls through into it, and the EOF jge is the only repeated back-edge; failing-first shape and refusal tests pass, emitted disassembly confirms no per-byte unconditional jump, 208 codegen/IR and 775 end-to-end tests (including four-language twin parity) passed after the final code; paired A/B with a -0.1 percent identical-binary control measured 6.86 to 6.53 ms best (-4.8 percent) on identical 4 MiB output; ADR-095 and README synced; checklists: passed
Task 'cairn-stdin-scan-rotation' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/1] add an optimizer pass that keeps a linear function of a unit-step counted index in an incremented local, so many_params no longer recomputes 144*i+584 with imul and add; failing-first tests and refusals, paired A/B with identical-binary control, ADR, full suite and gates

impact_assessment.why: a controlled A/B measured many_params at 1.03x C and disassembly showed gcc keeps 144*i+584 in an incremented register while Cairn recomputes it each trip
impact_assessment.benefits: one fewer instruction per loop iteration; a 40-round paired A/B with a +0.6 percent control measured -10.8 percent best with identical output
impact_assessment.risks: contract: wrapping i64 arithmetic must stay exact; dependency: no new language surface or instruction; concurrency: none; state: the pass allocates one new frame slot per linear term
impact_assessment.mitigation: match only a strict '<' loop with a literal unit step and no break or continue or nested if, refuse other shapes, and pin semantics with end-to-end and four-language twin-parity tests
